SRC-073:R1.text: [PERF-004] the passive inbox freshness budget must exceed the active dashboard cadence (MainWindow.BRIDGE_POLL_ACTIVE_MS=4000) by a meaningful margin so a normal 4-second repaint is served from zero-I/O passive state; the freshness age must default to time.monotonic(); expiry must perform exactly one physical probe; invalidate_inbox_cache/force must remain immediate; regressions must pin the real 4.0s cadence, timer jitter, 20s/100-root bounded scan ratio, and monotonic-vs-wall-clock isolation
